_comment: The pinned stack. Identical across every variant — this file is the single
source for the component layer, and every entry in config/platforms/ must
reference it rather than restating a value. `plan` refuses to launch when a
platform's live config diverges from what is declared here.
Transport is deliberately absent: it is the one layer declared per platform
rather than pinned, and lives on the variant row.

llm._why: Pinnable on every platform under test, so model choice cannot explain a difference between them. Reasoning quality is not what this benchmark measures.

stt._why: Already benched on the Coval STT board, so its contribution is known. nova-2-medical is not available on any hosted platform, so domain vocabulary is recovered through keyterm prompting instead — generated from the mock fixtures, never hand-maintained.
stt._limitation: Any platform that cannot serve nova-3 falls back to Deepgram general, and the substitution is recorded per variant in the published Limitations.

tts._why: Reachable on every platform under test, either natively or as a third-party engine. Pinning synthesis keeps time-to-first-audio out of the latency comparison.
tts._verify: Confirm voice_id resolves to Sarah in the ElevenLabs voice library before the first apply.

turn_taking._why: Targeted on every platform that exposes a threshold. Platforms that do not expose one are named as a stated limit rather than silently left at a default.
turn_taking._note: This is the layer under test. It is targeted for parity, not tuned for performance — no benchmark-specific optimisation on any variant.

media._why: G.711 mu-law. Load-bearing rather than cosmetic: Telnyx offers L16 at 16 kHz and Coval's audio_codec accepts either, so an unpinned variant would face materially lower word error — landing straight on the identity-repair scenario class.

platform_behaviour._why: Hangup must be prompt-driven so EndReasonMetric can verify the agent terminated cleanly. A vendor's own success evaluation must never run, or two different rubrics get published as one.
